Editing a .dav file and running language diagnostics
When the .dav file changes in the editor, the extension host parses the syntax tree with Lezer and
updates diagnostics, Quick Fixes, completions and outline symbols.
Computing the layout and reducing edge crossings
computeLayout assigns columns from the longest edge paths, places groups and rows, and runs up
to 16 barycenter passes to minimize crossings.
Resolving the step scene and rendering the live preview
resolveView computes cumulative step state, Bezier rails and callout boxes, then buildScene creates
the virtual SVG tree that Player mounts in the webview.
Playing step animations and syncing the cursor
During playback, Player animates packets phase by phase while syncing cursor highlights and
exportHtml embeds the parsed document, layout, used icons and runtime player into a single HTML
file locked down by a SHA-256 Content Security Policy.
